# RankUp

> Real-time sponsored rankings across curated categories. Boost visibility for your product.

RankUp is a transparent product discovery and sponsored directory platform allowing products, projects, and creators to secure real-time ranked placement across categories and daily listings.

## Core Navigation Links
- [Global Leaderboard](https://rankup.cyou/): Real-time live sponsored rankings, stats, and active top spots across all categories.
- [Category Directory](https://rankup.cyou/categories): Browse top categories, niches, and featured products.
- [Daily Listings](https://rankup.cyou/daily): Today's active claims, sponsored placements, and highest performers.
- [Rules & Guidelines](https://rankup.cyou/rules): How sponsored placement calculation and directory rankings work.
- [Contact Support](https://rankup.cyou/contact): Feedback, support, and inquiries.
- [Terms of Service](https://rankup.cyou/terms): Platform terms and conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rankup.cyou/privacy): Privacy policy and data disclosures.

## Optional & Developer Endpoints
- [Health Check](https://rankup.cyou/api/health): System status and uptime endpoint.
- [Sitemap](https://rankup.cyou/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable XML sitemap.
